purpose: Machine-testable overlay of existing closeout authority. Does not create new authority or a new enterprise rule family.

rules.title: Substantive completion requires human-review evidence
rules.statement: A substantive task may not transition to COMPLETE, READY_FOR_DCS_REVIEW, CLOSED, or equivalent unless its human-review evidence contract is satisfied.

positive: Complete with accessible artifact, exact source identity, validation results, unresolved findings, and applicable review evidence.
negative: Complete with only a narrative completion claim.
boundary: Non-substantive administrative transition explicitly declares substantive=false.

rules.title: Browser-renderable work requires preview or documented equivalent
rules.statement: Browser-renderable work requires a working non-production preview or a self-contained review bundle with a working review index before review-ready completion.

positive: Self-contained ZIP plus review index, screenshots, exact SHA, hash manifest, and accessibility evidence.
boundary: Preview URL exists but is expired or inaccessible.

rules.title: Technical completion is not review readiness
rules.statement: When implementation and tests are complete but human-review evidence is incomplete, state must remain TECHNICALLY_COMPLETE / HUMAN_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_PENDING.

positive: Missing preview evidence yields remediation state without invalidating technical implementation.
negative: Worker self-declares READY_FOR_DCS_REVIEW despite missing review evidence.
boundary: Evidence becomes accessible after prior technical completion and transition is reevaluated.

rules.title: Review evidence must be accessible and source-bound
rules.statement: Review evidence must identify the exact source version/hash and include independent accessibility/probe evidence; an inaccessible or expired reference cannot support review-ready status.

positive: Artifact accessibility probe PASS with exact source SHA.
boundary: Artifact exists but accessibility evidence is missing.

rules.title: Review evidence requirements depend on artifact class
rules.statement: The closeout evidence contract must match the natural review form of the artifact: browser, file/package, runtime/database, or media.

positive: Database completion uses runtime query evidence and migration/runtime identity without browser preview.
negative: Browser build attempts to substitute source code link for rendered preview.
boundary: Document requires rendered preview only when raw source is not the natural human-review form.

rules.title: Evidence drift downgrades status
rules.statement: If previously accepted review evidence becomes inaccessible, mismatched, expired, or source-drifted before DCS decision, review-ready status must be downgraded and remediation opened.

positive: Accessible review package remains source-bound and valid.
negative: Preview expires before DCS review but READY_FOR_DCS_REVIEW remains asserted.
boundary: New package supersedes expired package and restores readiness after verification.

promotion_rule: Candidate overlay cannot self-promote. Runtime enforcement here is justified only by already-operative underlying authority; this artifact is provenance/normalization pending Rule Foundry reconciliation.
